surfaces.part: left and right side crystal shards

answer.evidence: The main body is a cluster of faceted crystal spires. Each spire is a vertical face with a pointed tip: the central one narrows from width 8 at row 9 to width 1 at rows 1-3, and the side shards also taper to a point. None has an ellipse or a flat horizontal top. Facets are shaded light to dark, with highlights at rows 1-2 and row 9, but these are vertical facets, not a top plane. Only the small maroon base at rows 25-30 has a weak top band (rows 25-27) with an edge line at row 28 and shadow at rows 29-30. That base is minor compared with the crystals, so the object reads as a front elevation.
